title: The retired tabs.tabBar.<kind> settings are refused as removed and change nothing; Hide Tab Bar (pane.toggleTabBar) and New Horizontal Tab (newTab.horizontal) run in a terminal pane
preconditions: private scratch config with no tabs key
a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab with the keyboard
converted from scripts/cmux-next/pane-tab-bar-e2e.py, which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-095.json links them

steps.note: script row 'settings.set tabs.tabBar.agent is refused as removed': the app answers removed (ControlRouter+Settings, schemas/settings/retired-keys.json), the CLI exits 1 with the error on stderr, so the driver's code is cli.failed
the palette's Hide Tab Bar on the focused terminal pane, the only way to hide a tab bar
script row 'New Horizontal Tab opens a tab in that pane' (it also turns the bar back on)

invariants: the settings facet at retired-setting's settled checkpoint equals its before checkpoint and the launch's: a removed key writes nothing
the launch workspace's one pane holds one more tab at after than at launched, and no workspace or pane was added
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: whether a pane's tab bar shows, and the toggle's title (Hide Tab Bar while it shows, Show Tab Bar while hidden) in the palette and the pane menu: debug.pane_chrome and debug.palette.entries only; no snapshot facet records a pane's tab bar or a palette row's title. Closing the gap needs a tabBarHidden field per pane in the layout or tabs facet
a chat in the left chat dock (Cmd-I) and a lone agent chat show their tab bar: the same missing field
an old cmux.json with tabs.tabBar never still loads and the bar shows: case-v1 has no step that edits the launch's config file
